title: Remove disputed Hawaiian photo identities from bushy bluestem public gallery
reason: After initial successful Anatherum/Sorghum publication, a source-index audit found three historic Hawaiian Starr photos still inside A. glomeratum images[]. The photo metadata for all three is now retained under historical_photo_exclusions; only original physically stored source-determined CC0 herbarium specimen remains in ordinary A. glomeratum species images[]. Original records untouched, not reassigned to another canonical gallery. Historic Andropogon glomeratus var. pumilus reference remains separate, explicitly labelled Anatherum tenuispatheum in Anatherum genus comparison per POWO 2026.
publication_policy: Separate explicit release to include latest source changes; standard Pages rights/size/photo QA. Never assert publication without success.
